title: PM-Eng 1:1 prep - Samir Kapoor / Lena Brooks
content:
Meeting: 1:1 w/ Lena Brooks (Eng Lead, Console & Routing)
Date/Time: 2026-03-02 10:00am PT (30m)
Location: Zoom / #eng-console
Purpose: sync on API/Console rollout plan, Dedicated capacity edge cases, Private onboarding blockers; unblock prioritization for Q2 deliverables.

Goals for this 1:1:
- Validate rollout timeline for new per-route throttling UX in Console (GA vs. staged).
- Confirm Dedicated capacity perf regression triage owners + next steps.
- Get clarity on Private deployment onboarding SLA for pilot customers.
- Surface any blocking infra/seq issues I should escalate.

Proposed agenda (30m):
1) Quick check-in (3m) - energy, capacity
2) Console throttling UX & rollout strategy (10m)
   - PRD summary: per-route throttling, defaults, advanced mode, telemetry changes
   - Key open questions: telemetry naming (route_id vs. policy_id), default policy for existing customers, migration plan for programmatic users
   - Risk: telemetry changes may break dashboards for CS; need short-term compatibility layer
3) Dedicated: perf regressions seen in nightly runs (8m)
   - Summary of failures: token throughput drop ~12% on <=8k batch sizes since kernel swap; failing on a subset of models (llama2-70b-quantized variant)
   - Suspect areas: kernel selection heuristics, seq-length edge case, packing logic change 2026-02-14
   - Ask: who owns triage? ETA for rollback vs patch?
4) Private onboarding (6m)
   - Pilot: AcmeHealth + FinCorp - timeline pressure (compliance + data residency)
   - Need: checklist signoff for KMS/HSM integration + clear network diagram for infra team
5) Action items / blockers (3m)

Notes / context to mention:
- Console rollout: PM signoff planned 2026-03-05. I want to avoid GA until CS has a compatibility shim ready. Consider canary per-tenant for 2 weeks.
- Telemetry: current metric names used in dashboards: console.requests.route, console.policy.exec. Proposed new names would flip route->policy which breaks saved queries; propose to add alias metrics for 30 days.
- Dedicated regression: I added failing CI links to RINF-4321; I believe recent kernel heuristics intended to improve latency at high batch sizes but regressed small-batch throughput. Nightly repro attached in GH PR 984.
- Private: onboarding doc draft (linked) still missing final network diagrams and KMS contact info from infra. AcmeHealth legal now asking for retention policy details.

Questions to ask Lena:
- Do you prefer to prioritize rolling back kernel heuristic or fast patch for packing logic? (Perf vs stability tradeoff)
- Can we get a small on-call rotation to own Dedicated triage for next 2 sprints? Who would you nominate?
- For Console telemetry change: is engineering comfortable adding aliases for metrics for 30d? Cost/ops impact?
- For Private pilot: who on infra should I loop in for a one-off architecture review this week?

Draft follow-ups / action items (put into Asana / JIRA after 1:1):
- Action: Create canary rollout plan for per-route throttling (steps, metrics, rollback). Owner: Samir Kapoor. Due: 2026-03-05.
- Action: Add alias metrics for telemetry change + document migration notes for CS. Owner: Eng Observability (Lena to assign). Due: 2026-03-09.
- Action: Triage Dedicated perf regression: capture repro, run A/B compare w/ previous kernel. Owner: Jordan Khan (eng). Due: 2026-03-04.
- Action: Decide rollback vs patch and execute. Owner: Lena Brooks. Due: 2026-03-06.
- Action: Private onboarding: finalize KMS/HSM checklist and network diagram; set architecture review meeting with infra. Owner: Samir Kapoor + Infra (TBD). Due: 2026-03-08.
- Action: Update customer-facing status note for AcmeHealth pilot (cc: CS). Owner: Samir Kapoor. Due: 2026-03-03.

Backlog items to flag (not for immediate 1:1 but worth tracking):
- Improve canary tooling for per-tenant feature flags (prod safety + telemetry)
- Postmortem template for Dedicated infra regressions (short postmortem + perf benchmark)

Prep reminders for me (Samir):
- Have RINF-4321 and GH PR 984 open in call; share repro logs (link pasted above).
- Bring proposed rollout RBAC doc (short) to alignment meeting with CS next Wed.
- Be ready to propose a 2-week canary schedule with metrics and success criteria.

Tone/ask guidance: keep ask concrete (rollback vs patch) and give Lena two clear options with tradeoffs. Avoid drifting into broader product debates in this short 1:1 - keep focused on unblock.

-- End of notes --
